figures.finding: Nicaragua has no rule of its own for child performers: paid work is barred under fourteen; an adolescent has capacity to sign an employment contract from sixteen, and from fourteen to sixteen may contract with the parents' or legal representative's permission under the Ministry of Labour's supervision; adolescents may not work in night entertainment venues or at night generally, or long hours.
